parameterization: Same projection parameters and initial state as band/broadband controls; first half reads band signals, second half reads raw waveform.
tradeoff: Each content source has 32 coordinates instead of its single-source control's 64; exact token coordinates are preserved, not invertibility of either signal.
motivation: Completed seed-0 TUEV favors band content; completed Sleep-EDF, TUAR and ISRUC favor broadband content.
Live CHB-MIT logs show best validation PR-AUC .6730 for band and .4289 for broadband; broadband is still improving and this is not a completed comparison.
admission_conditions: Review completed TUEV seed-0 scale pair and TUAR f2 seed-1 confirmation first.
If admitted, use an existing compatible allocation with sufficient remaining time; do not add a pretraining run.
Reuse eligible f1 seed-1 controls on mi2104x; verify complete configs, cohorts and execution provenance before comparison.
